Add the butter, garlic and thyme to the pan and spoon over the steak.
Steam the broccoli and toss it in the pan butter.

title: Garlic butter prawns with courgetti
steps: Spiralise or finely slice the courgette.
Cook the garlic in the butter and oil, add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Toss in the courgette for 1 minute with lemon and parsley.
Serve topped with parmesan.

title: Chicken Caesar salad, no croutons
steps: Season and grill the chicken for 5 minutes a side, then slice.
Mix the mayonnaise, oil, lemon, garlic and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with the chicken and remaining parmesan.

title: Anda masala (egg curry)
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and score them.
Fry the onion in the ghee, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the tomato.
Cook to a thick masala, stir in the cream and add the eggs for 3 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

title: Cauliflower cheese
steps: Boil the cauliflower florets for 5 minutes and drain well.
Melt most of the cheddar into the cream and butter with the mustard and nutmeg.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Tuna mayo avocado boats
steps: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise, spring onion, lemon and pepper.
Halve and stone the avocado and pile the tuna into the halves.

title: Devilled eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and halve.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika.

title: Macadamias with cheddar and cucumber
steps: Slice the cheddar and cucumber.
Serve with the macadamias.

title: Smoked salmon cucumber bites
steps: Cut the cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with cream cheese, a fold of smoked salmon, dill and pepper.

title: Egg white and cheddar omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter, pour in the eggs and stir gently until the base sets.
Add the spinach and grated cheddar, fold and cook for 1 more minute.

title: Pan-seared salmon with garlic spinach
steps: Season the salmon and cook skin-side down in half the oil for 5 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the rest of the oil.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Gulf-spiced grilled mackerel with salad
steps: Rub the mackerel with the garlic, turmeric, cumin, pepper, salt and half the lemon.
Grill for 4 minutes a side until cooked through.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and parsley and dress with the oil and remaining lemon.

title: Sardines with rocket and olive oil
steps: Pile the rocket on a plate and lay the sardines on top.
Dress with the oil, lemon and pepper.

title: Chicken thighs with avocado salsa
steps: Rub the chicken with the cumin, chilli, salt and half the oil.
Pan-fry for 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Dice the avocado, tomato and onion and mix with the lime, coriander and remaining oil.
Spoon the salsa over the chicken.

title: Tandoori chicken wings
steps: Mix the yoghurt, spices, garlic, ginger, lemon and salt and coat the wings.
Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes, brushing with the ghee halfway, until charred and cooked through.

title: Beef seekh kebab with raita
steps: Mix both minces with the grated onion, chilli, coriander, spices and salt and squeeze onto skewers.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the ghee.
Stir the grated cucumber and mint into the yoghurt for raita.

title: Turkey and Swiss cheese roll-ups
steps: Lay out the turkey slices and spread thinly with mayonnaise.
Add a strip of cheese and a lettuce leaf and roll up tightly.

title: Celery with almond butter
steps: Cut the celery into sticks.
Spread or dip with the almond butter.

title: Marinated olives and feta
steps: Cube the feta and toss with the olives, oil and oregano.
Leave for 10 minutes for the flavours to mix.

title: Pecan and coconut bites
steps: Chop the pecans finely and mix with the coconut, cinnamon and melted coconut oil.
Press into small mounds on a lined tray and chill for 20 minutes until firm.

title: Parmesan crisps with guacamole
steps: Spoon the grated parmesan into small rounds on a lined tray and bake at 200 °C for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lime, onion, coriander and salt.
Serve the crisps with the guacamole.

title: Keema palak (lamb mince with spinach)
steps: Fry the onion in the ghee until golden, then add the ginger, garlic, chilli and spices.
Add the lamb mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes, then the chopped spinach.
Simmer uncovered until the spinach melts into the keema.

title: Spiced lamb and aubergine skillet
steps: Cube the aubergine and fry in the ghee until soft and browned, then set aside.
Brown the lamb with the garlic and spices.
Stir in the tomato paste and a splash of water, return the aubergine and cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

title: Coconut prawn curry with spinach
steps: Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the coconut oil, then add the turmeric and chilli.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and spinach and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the prawns turn pink.
Finish with lime and coriander.

title: Beef chili bowl with sour cream and avocado
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the onion, pepper and garlic.
Add the spices and chopped tomato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve topped with grated cheddar, sour cream and sliced avocado.

title: Salmon and avocado salad
steps: Roast or pan-fry the salmon for 10 minutes, cool slightly and flake.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon and dill.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber and avocado and top with the salmon and dressing.

title: Labneh, chickpea and za’atar bowl
steps: Season the yoghurt with salt and spread it thickly in a bowl.
Top with the drained chickpeas, diced cucumber and tomato.
Mix the thyme and sesame for a quick za’atar and scatter over with the mint.
Finish with the oil and lemon.

title: Paneer tikka with kachumber salad
steps: Cube the paneer and coat with half the yoghurt, the garlic, ginger, spices, half the lemon and salt.
Thread onto skewers with the pepper and onion and grill or roast at 220 °C for 12 minutes.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and coriander with the rest of the lemon for the salad.
Serve the tikka with the salad and the remaining yoghurt as a dip.

title: Spinach, ricotta and lentil bake
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the oil and mix with the lentils and half the passata.
Spread in a dish, spoon over the ricotta and remaining passata and scatter with parmesan.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes and finish with basil.

title: Ricotta, yoghurt and berry protein bowl
steps: Beat the ricotta and yoghurt together until smooth.
Top with the berries, hemp seeds and a drizzle of honey.

title: Whey, banana and milk smoothie
steps: Blend everything with a few ice cubes until smooth.
Drink straight away.

title: Labneh pot with cucumber and mint
steps: Season the yoghurt with salt and spoon into a bowl.
Top with diced cucumber, torn mint, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of paprika.

title: Cottage cheese and lentil salad
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender, drain and cool.
Toss with the chopped tomato, cucumber, rocket, oil and vinegar.
Top with the cottage cheese.

title: Chicken biryani
steps: Soak the rice for 20 minutes, then boil it in salted water with the bay leaf until three-quarters cooked and drain.
Fry the sliced onions in the oil until deep golden and set half aside.
Add the ginger, garlic, chicken, tomatoes, yogurt and spices to the pan and cook for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and the masala is thick.
Layer the rice over the chicken, scatter with the reserved onions, mint and coriander, cover tightly and steam on the lowest heat for 15 minutes.
Fold gently from the sides and serve.

title: Beef yakhni pulao
steps: Simmer the beef with half the onion, the ginger, garlic, fennel, coriander, cloves, bay and salt in 1.2 litres of water for 50 minutes until tender, then strain and keep the stock.
Brown the remaining sliced onion in the oil with the cumin, cardamom and pepper.
Stir in the beef and yogurt and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed rice and 600 ml of the stock, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

title: Daal mash (dry-style urad dal) with roti
steps: Rinse the dal and simmer it with the turmeric and salt for about 20 minutes until tender but still holding its shape, then drain.
Fry the onion in the ghee with the cumin until golden, then add the garlic, tomato and chilli powder and cook to a thick masala.
Fold in the dal and cook for 3 minutes so it stays dry and separate.
Top with ginger matchsticks, green chilli and coriander and serve with warm roti.

title: Toor dal tadka with rice
steps: Rinse the dal and simmer it with the turmeric, tomato and salt for 30 minutes until soft, then whisk until smooth.
Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Heat the ghee and sizzle the cumin, mustard seed, sliced garlic and onion until golden, then stir in the chilli powder.
Pour the tadka over the dal, finish with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Moong masoor dal with roti
steps: Rinse both lentils and simmer them with the turmeric, ginger and salt in 700 ml of water for 20 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin until golden, add the tomato and chilli powder and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir the tadka into the dal and simmer for 2 minutes.
Finish with lemon and coriander and serve with roti.

title: Lobia masala (black-eyed pea curry) with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Brown the onion in the oil with the cumin, then add the ginger, garlic and ground spices.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Stir in the drained black-eyed peas with a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Finish with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Kaleji masala (spiced beef liver) with roti
steps: Cut the liver into small cubes and pat dry.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then add the ginger, garlic and spices.
Add the tomato and cook until it breaks down.
Add the liver and cook on high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until just cooked through; do not overcook or it turns tough.
Finish with lemon, green chilli and coriander and serve with roti.

title: Aloo keema (beef mince and potato curry)
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, then add the ginger, garlic and mince and fry until the mince is no longer pink.
Stir in the spices, salt and tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced potato and 200 ml of water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Uncover and cook until the oil separates, then finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: White chicken karahi with naan
steps: Sear the chicken in the oil until lightly coloured.
Add the onion, ginger and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, pepper, cumin and salt and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the cream and slit green chillies, cook for 2 minutes and finish with coriander.
Serve with warm naan.

title: Achari chicken with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Warm the oil and let the mustard, fennel, fenugreek and cumin seeds crackle for a few seconds.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then add the chicken and brown it.
Stir in the tomato, yogurt, chilli, turmeric and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Sharpen with lemon and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken shami kebabs with salad and roti
steps: Simmer the chicken, split chickpeas, ginger, garlic, cumin, chilli and salt in just enough water to cover for 30 minutes until the chickpeas are soft and the pan is dry.
Blend to a coarse paste, then mix in the egg, finely chopped onion, coriander and mint.
Shape into 8 patties and pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with the salad, yogurt and roti.

title: Goat karahi with roti
steps: Simmer the goat with the garlic, salt and 300 ml of water, covered, for 40 minutes until almost tender.
Add the ghee and fry on high heat until the meat is browned.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook, stirring, until they collapse into a thick sauce that clings to the meat.
Finish with ginger matchsticks, green chillies and coriander and serve with roti.

title: Aloo gosht (goat and potato curry) with rice
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, then add the goat, ginger and garlic and fry for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato, yogurt, spices and salt and cook until the oil separates.
Add 500 ml of water, cover and simmer for 45 minutes until the meat is tender.
Add the potato chunks and cook for 15 minutes more.
Cook the rice, then serve the curry over it with coriander.

title: Palak gosht (lamb and spinach curry)
steps: Brown the onion in the ghee, then add the lamb, ginger and garlic and sear.
Add the tomato, yogurt, spices and salt and cook until thick.
Pour in 250 ml of water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped spinach and cook uncovered for 10 minutes until the sauce clings to the meat.
Serve with roti.

title: Chicken seekh kebab roll
steps: Mix the mince with half the onion (finely chopped), the ginger, garlic, chilli, coriander, spices and salt and shape into 4 long kebabs.
Grill or pan-fry for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Blend the yogurt with the mint and lemon.
Warm the rotis, add the kebabs, sliced onion and cucumber, drizzle with the mint yogurt and roll up.

title: Bun kebab-style lentil and egg patty sandwich
steps: Boil the lentils and diced potato together for 15 minutes until soft, drain well and mash with the cumin, chilli and salt.
Shape into 2 flat patties, dip in the beaten egg and pan-fry in the oil until golden on both sides.
Pour any leftover egg into the pan and fold it around the patties.
Toast the bread, spread with tamarind loosened with water and fill with the patties, onion, cucumber and mint.

title: Lahori-style pan-fried fish with salad
steps: Rub the fish with the lemon, garlic, spices and salt and leave for 10 minutes.
Dust both sides with the gram flour.
Pan-fry in the hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes each side until crisp and the flesh flakes.
Serve with the sliced salad vegetables and warm roti.

title: Machli ka salan (masala fish curry) with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the tomato and yogurt, and cook to a thick masala.
Add 200 ml of water and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the fish pieces, cover and cook gently for 8 minutes without stirring.
Finish with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Prawn masala with roti
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then add the ginger, garlic and spices.
Add the tomato and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until thick and jammy.
Stir in the prawns and green chilli and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: Daal gosht (beef and split chickpea stew)
steps: Soak the split chickpeas for at least 1 hour.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the beef, ginger and garlic and sear, then stir in the tomato, spices and salt.
Add the drained chickpeas and 800 ml of water, cover and simmer for 75 minutes until the meat and dal are both tender.
Cook the rice in salted water.
Serve the stew over the rice with coriander.

title: Lauki chana dal (bottle gourd and split chickpeas)
steps: Soak the split chickpeas for 30 minutes, then simmer with the turmeric for 20 minutes.
Fry the onion and garlic in the ghee with the cumin, add the tomato and chilli powder and cook until soft.
Add the peeled, cubed gourd and the par-cooked chickpeas with their liquid and the salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until both are tender and the sauce is thick.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: Sarson ka saag with cornmeal roti
steps: Simmer the chopped greens with the ginger, green chilli, half the salt and 200 ml of water for 25 minutes, then mash or blend coarsely.
Fry the onion and garlic in the ghee until golden, stir into the greens with a spoon of the cornmeal and cook for 5 minutes.
Mix the remaining cornmeal with the rest of the salt and enough hot water to form a dough, then pat out 4 small rotis.
Cook the rotis on a hot dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side.
Top the saag with the butter and serve with the rotis and yogurt.

title: Karhi with spinach (yogurt and gram flour curry)
steps: Whisk the yogurt, gram flour, turmeric, chilli and salt with 500 ml of water until smooth.
Soften the onion, ginger and garlic in half the oil, pour in the yogurt mixture and bring to a simmer, stirring.
Cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick, then add the spinach for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted water.
Sizzle the mustard, cumin and fenugreek seeds in the remaining oil, pour over the karhi and serve with the rice.

title: Aloo palak with roti and yogurt
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin until golden.
Add the tomato, turmeric, chilli and salt and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the cubed potato and a splash of water, cover and cook for 12 minutes until almost tender.
Stir in the chopped spinach and cook uncovered for 6 minutes until the pan is nearly dry.
Serve with roti and yogurt.

title: Baingan bharta (smoky aubergine mash) with peas
steps: Char the whole aubergines over a flame or under a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until the skin is black and the flesh is soft.
Peel and mash the flesh.
Fry the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil with the cumin, add the tomato and cook until soft.
Stir in the aubergine, peas, chilli powder and salt and cook for 8 minutes.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti and yogurt.

title: Mix sabzi (mixed vegetable curry) with roti
steps: Fry the onion in the oil with the cumin until golden, then add the ginger, garlic and spices.
Add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the diced potato with a splash of water, cover and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and salt and cook for 8 minutes more until everything is tender.
Serve with roti and yogurt.

title: Chicken yakhni soup
steps: Put the chicken, onion, carrot, garlic, ginger and pepper in a pot with the stock and 300 ml of water.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes, skimming, until the chicken falls from the bone.
Shred the meat back into the broth and season with salt and lemon.
Finish with coriander and serve with warm roti.

title: Chicken corn soup
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 12 minutes, lift it out and shred it.
Add the sweetcorn, roughly crushing half of it, and return the chicken to the pot.
Stir the cornflour into a little cold water, add it to the soup and simmer until lightly thickened.
Pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring to form ribbons.
Season with soy, vinegar, pepper and salt and top with spring onion.

title: Khagina (spiced scrambled eggs) with roti
steps: Soften the onion in the ghee with the cumin, then add the tomato, chilli and spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs with the salt.
Stir gently over low heat until just set in soft curds.
Scatter with coriander and serve with a warm roti.

title: Aloo paratha with yogurt
steps: Boil the potato until tender, mash and mix with the chilli, coriander, cumin and half the salt.
Knead the flour with the remaining salt and about 45 ml of water into a soft dough.
Roll the dough into a disc, wrap it around the potato filling, seal and roll out gently again.
Cook on a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side, brushing with the ghee, until golden.
Serve with the yogurt.

title: Lahori chanay with boiled egg
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the spices and tomato and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas with 100 ml of water and simmer for 6 minutes, crushing a few to thicken the sauce.
Halve the eggs over the chickpeas and serve with roti.

title: Sweet dalia porridge with dates and almonds
steps: Toast the cracked wheat in a dry pan for 2 minutes until it smells nutty.
Add the milk, cardamom and 100 ml of water and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the chopped dates.
Top with sliced almonds.

title: Savoury vegetable dalia with egg
steps: Soften the onion in the ghee with the cumin, then add the carrot, peas, tomato and turmeric.
Stir in the cracked wheat, salt and 250 ml of water.
Cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the wheat is tender and the water is absorbed.
Top with the eggs, fried or boiled.

title: Salted mint lassi
steps: Put the yogurt, mint, cumin and salt in a blender with 100 ml of cold water.
Blend for 30 seconds until frothy.
Pour over ice and drink straight away.

title: Desi-style cardamom French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk, sugar and cardamom.
Soak the bread slices in the mixture for 30 seconds each side.
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve hot.

title: Tikka chicken bites with mint raita
steps: Cube the chicken and coat it with half the yogurt, the lemon, ginger, garlic, spices and salt.
Grill or air-fry at 200 °C for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Stir the chopped mint into the remaining yogurt.
Serve the bites with the raita.

title: Masala corn and chickpea cup
steps: Boil or microwave the sweetcorn and drained chickpeas for 3 to 4 minutes until hot, then drain.
Toss with the butter, lemon, chilli, cumin and salt.
Serve warm in a cup.

title: Egg chaat
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and quarter.
Loosen the tamarind with a spoon of warm water.
Top the eggs with the chopped onion, tomato and chilli.
Drizzle with the tamarind and dust with cumin, chilli powder, salt and coriander.

title: Black-eyed pea chaat
steps: Drain and rinse the black-eyed peas.
Finely chop the onion, tomato and cucumber.
Toss everything with the lemon, oil, spices and salt.
Finish with coriander.

title: Murgh cholay (chicken and chickpea curry)
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, then add the ginger, garlic and chicken and sear.
Stir in the tomato, spices and salt and cook until the oil separates.
Add the drained chickpeas and 250 ml of water and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: Beef bhuna with roti
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, add the beef, ginger and garlic and sear well.
Stir in the tomato, yogurt, spices and salt and cook until thick.
Add 300 ml of water, cover and simmer for 60 minutes until the beef is tender.
Uncover and fry on high heat, stirring, until the masala is dark and clings to the meat.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: Tawa chicken with peppers and naan
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips and toss with the yogurt, ginger, garlic, spices and salt.
Sear on a very hot flat pan in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and tomato and cook, chopping and stirring, for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the masala is thick.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve with warm naan.

title: Reshmi chicken kebabs with salad
steps: Grind the cashews to a powder and mix with the mince, finely chopped onion, ginger, garlic, chilli, coriander, cream, spices and salt.
Shape into 6 kebabs around skewers, or into short sausages.
Grill or pan-fry for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the sliced salad, yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Keema shimla mirch (mince with peppers)
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and mince and fry until browned.
Stir in the tomato, spices and salt and cook for 8 minutes until thick.
Add the diced peppers and cook for 4 to 5 minutes so they keep a little bite.
Serve with roti.

title: Murgh daal (chicken with red lentils)
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and cubed chicken and sear.
Stir in the tomato, spices and salt, then the rinsed lentils and 500 ml of water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils have broken down around the chicken.
Finish with lemon and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Kofta curry (beef meatball curry) with rice
steps: Mix the mince with a third of the onion (finely chopped), the gram flour, half the ginger and garlic, the cumin and half the salt, and roll into 10 meatballs.
Brown the remaining onion in the oil, add the rest of the ginger and garlic, the tomato, yogurt, spices and salt and cook to a smooth masala.
Add 300 ml of water, bring to a simmer and lower in the meatballs.
Cover and cook gently for 20 minutes, shaking the pan rather than stirring.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry and coriander.

title: Shaljam gosht (lamb and turnip curry)
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, add the lamb, ginger and garlic and sear.
Stir in the tomato, spices and salt and cook until thick.
Add 350 ml of water, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Add the turnip wedges and cook for 20 minutes more until the meat and turnip are both tender.
Finish with coriander and serve with roti.

title: Sajji-style roast chicken with rice
steps: Score the chicken and rub it with the lemon, garlic, pepper, cumin, coriander, oil and most of the salt.
Roast at 200 °C for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until the skin is deep golden and the juices run clear.
Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Serve the chicken on the rice with sliced cucumber and onion.

title: Peshawari namkeen gosht (salt and pepper lamb)
steps: Put the lamb, garlic, salt and 300 ml of water in a heavy pan, cover and simmer for 35 minutes until tender and the water has almost gone.
Add the ghee and fry the meat until browned.
Add the tomato, pepper and half the ginger and cook until the tomato melts into the meat.
Finish with the green chillies and the remaining ginger and serve with naan.

title: Kabuli pulao (lamb, carrot and raisin rice)
steps: Brown the onion in most of the oil until dark golden, add the lamb and sear.
Add the cumin, cardamom, cinnamon, salt and 700 ml of water and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes until tender.
Soften the carrot matchsticks and raisins in the remaining oil for 3 minutes.
Stir the rinsed rice into the lamb and its broth, top with the carrot and raisins, cover and cook on low heat for 18 minutes.
Scatter with the almonds and serve.

title: Chana pulao with raita
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the cumin, cinnamon, cardamom, bay and pepper.
Add the drained chickpeas and the rinsed rice and stir for a minute.
Pour in 320 ml of water with most of the salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber, mint and a pinch of salt.
Fluff the pulao and serve with the raita.

title: Daal palak (lentils with spinach) and rice
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric in 700 ml of water for 25 minutes until soft.
Stir in the chopped spinach, tomato and salt and cook for 8 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Fry the onion and garlic in the ghee with the cumin and chilli until golden and pour over the dal.
Serve with the rice.

title: Tuna and potato cutlets with yogurt
steps: Boil the potato until tender, drain well and mash.
Mix in the drained tuna, finely chopped onion, chilli, coriander, spices and salt and shape into 6 patties.
Dip in the beaten egg, coat in the breadcrumbs and pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve with the cucumber and yogurt.

title: Chicken shashlik with egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, spread it out and let it cool.
Sear the cubed chicken in half the oil until golden, add the garlic, peppers and onion and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the ketchup, vinegar, chilli and two-thirds of the soy sauce and toss until the chicken is cooked through and glazed.
In a second pan scramble the egg in the remaining oil, add the carrot and rice and fry for 3 minutes with the rest of the soy and the salt.
Top the rice with the shashlik and spring onion.

title: Moong dal khichdi with yogurt
steps: Rinse the rice and dal together.
Warm the ghee, sizzle the cumin and ginger, then stir in the rice, dal, turmeric and salt.
Add 700 ml of water, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until soft and porridge-like.
Serve with the yogurt.

title: Guava and pomegranate yogurt chaat
steps: Cut the guava into bite-sized wedges.
Whisk the yogurt with the cumin, pepper and salt.
Fold in the guava and top with the pomegranate seeds.

title: Adai (mixed lentil crepes) with coconut chutney
steps: Soak the lentils, split chickpeas and rice together for at least 2 hours, then drain.
Blend with the ginger, chilli, cumin, most of the salt and about 200 ml of water to a thick, slightly grainy batter.
Blend the coconut with the yogurt, coriander and a pinch of salt for the chutney.
Spread a ladle of batter thinly in a lightly oiled hot pan and cook for 2 minutes each side until golden; repeat with the rest.
Serve the crepes with the chutney.

title: Sambar with rice
steps: Simmer the dal with the turmeric in 700 ml of water for 30 minutes until soft, then whisk smooth.
Add the chopped vegetables, tomato, chilli, coriander, salt and the tamarind loosened in a little water, and simmer for 12 minutes until tender.
Cook the rice in salted water.
Crackle the mustard and fenugreek seeds in the oil and pour over the sambar.
Serve ladled over the rice.

title: Matar paneer with roti
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the cumin, then add the ginger, garlic and ground spices.
Add the tomato and cook for 6 minutes to a thick sauce, loosening with a splash of water.
Stir in the peas and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cubed paneer and warm through for 3 minutes.
Serve with roti.

title: Kadai paneer with peppers and rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the tomato, and cook until thick.
Add the pepper chunks and cook for 4 minutes so they stay crisp.
Fold in the cubed paneer and salt and heat through.
Serve with the rice.

title: South Indian egg and coconut curry
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Cook the rice in salted water.
Crackle the mustard seeds in the oil, add the onion and cook until golden, then stir in the curry powder, turmeric and tomato.
Pour in the coconut milk with 100 ml of water and the salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the eggs, warm through and serve over the rice with coriander.

title: Chettinad-style pepper chicken with rice
steps: Toast the coconut, pepper, fennel, coriander and cumin in a dry pan for 2 minutes and grind to a powder.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and chicken and sear.
Stir in the tomato, chilli, cinnamon, salt and the ground spice mix, then add 200 ml of water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice and serve with the chicken.

title: Vindaloo-style chicken and potato curry
steps: Mix the vinegar, garlic, ginger, chilli, paprika, cumin, cinnamon, sugar and salt to a paste and coat the chicken; rest for 10 minutes.
Crackle the mustard seeds in the oil and brown the onion.
Add the chicken and its paste and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the cubed potato and 250 ml of water and simmer for 20 minutes until both are tender.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.

title: Lamb rogan josh with rice
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Cook the onion in the same pan until deep golden, then add the ginger, garlic and all the spices.
Stir in the tomato paste and yogurt a spoon at a time.
Return the lamb with 300 ml of water and the salt, cover and simmer for 55 minutes until tender.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry.

title: Baked chicken 65-style bites
steps: Cube the chicken and coat with the yogurt, cornflour, spices, ginger, garlic, lemon and salt.
Spread on an oiled tray and drizzle with the oil.
Bake at 220 °C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges and cooked through.
Serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Bengali-style mustard trout with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Mix the mustard, crushed mustard seeds, yogurt, turmeric, oil, lemon and salt and coat the trout fillets.
Lay the fish in a baking dish with the slit chillies and bake at 200 °C for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan.
Serve the fish and its sauce over the rice with the spinach.

title: Prawn and pea pulao
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the cumin, cardamom and cinnamon.
Add the ginger, garlic, turmeric and rinsed rice and stir for a minute.
Pour in 320 ml of water with the salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes.
Scatter the prawns and peas over the rice, cover again and cook for 6 minutes until the prawns are pink.
Fluff and serve with the yogurt and coriander.

title: Vegetable korma with cashews and rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Blend the cashews with the yogurt and 100 ml of water until smooth.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the cauliflower, carrot and beans with 150 ml of water, and cook covered for 10 minutes.
Stir in the peas, cashew sauce and salt and simmer gently for 5 minutes without boiling hard.
Serve over the rice.

title: Tofu butter masala
steps: Cook the brown rice until tender.
Pan-fry the cubed tofu in half the oil until golden and set aside.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the passata and cashews, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth and stir in the coconut milk and salt.
Return the tofu, simmer for 3 minutes and serve with the rice.

title: Pav bhaji-style vegetable mash with toasted buns
steps: Boil the potato, cauliflower and peas for 12 minutes until very soft, then drain and keep a cup of the water.
Soften most of the onion and the pepper in the butter, add the tomato and spices and cook to a paste.
Add the boiled vegetables and the salt and mash in the pan, loosening with the cooking water, for 5 minutes.
Toast the bread.
Top the mash with the remaining raw onion, lemon and coriander and serve with the toast.

title: Semolina uttapam with tomato and onion
steps: Mix the semolina, yogurt, salt and about 80 ml of water to a thick batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Stir in half the chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Pour into a lightly oiled pan in 2 thick pancakes and press the remaining vegetables on top.
Cook for 3 minutes each side over medium heat until golden.

title: Savoury masala oats with a fried egg
steps: Soften the onion in most of the oil with the cumin, then add the tomato, mixed vegetables and spices.
Stir in the oats, salt and 250 ml of water and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Serve the oats topped with the eggs.

title: Paneer paratha with yogurt
steps: Knead the flour with a pinch of salt and about 45 ml of water into a soft dough.
Crumble the paneer and mix with the coriander, chilli, cumin and remaining salt.
Roll the dough into a disc, enclose the filling and roll out again gently.
Cook on a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side, brushing with the ghee, until golden and blistered.
Serve with the yogurt.

title: Egg kathi roll
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt and chilli powder.
Pour into the hot oiled pan, lay the roti on top while the egg is still wet and cook for 1 minute.
Flip and warm the roti side for 30 seconds.
Fill with the onion, cucumber, chilli, coriander and lemon, roll up and eat warm.

title: Curd rice with pomegranate and peanuts
steps: Cook the rice until very soft, then mash lightly and let it cool for a few minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, salt, grated cucumber and ginger.
Crackle the mustard seeds, chilli and peanuts in the oil and pour over the rice.
Top with the pomegranate seeds.

title: Lemon peanut rice with boiled eggs
steps: Cook the rice in salted water and boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Crackle the mustard seeds in the oil, then add the peanuts and chilli and fry until golden.
Stir in the turmeric, the rice and the lemon and toss until evenly yellow.
Serve with the halved eggs.

title: Bhel-style puffed rice and chickpea chaat
steps: Loosen the tamarind with a spoon of water and the lemon.
Toss the drained chickpeas with the chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, peanuts, chilli and salt.
Add the puffed rice and tamarind at the last moment and mix quickly.
Top with coriander and eat straight away while crisp.

title: Paneer tikka bites
steps: Cube the paneer and pepper and coat with the yogurt, lemon, spices and salt.
Thread onto skewers or spread on a tray.
Grill on high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges.

title: Mango lassi protein shake
steps: Put the yogurt, mango, whey, milk and cardamom in a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy.
Serve cold.

title: Roasted chickpeas with spiced chaas
steps: Dry the drained chickpeas, toss with the oil, chilli and half the salt and roast at 200 °C for 15 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the yogurt with 100 ml of cold water, the cumin, chopped mint and remaining salt.
Serve the chickpeas with the chaas to drink.

title: Tandoori prawns with kachumber and roti
steps: Coat the prawns with the yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger, oil, half the lemon and most of the salt.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and onion and dress with the remaining lemon and salt.
Grill the prawns on high heat for 2 to 3 minutes each side until pink and lightly charred.
Serve with the kachumber and warm roti.

title: Chicken dopiaza with roti
steps: Finely chop half the onions and cut the rest into large petals.
Brown the chopped onion in the oil, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the chicken, and sear.
Stir in the tomato, yogurt and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the onion petals and cook for 5 minutes so they soften but keep their shape.
Serve with roti.

title: Egg biryani
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and peel; par-boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes and drain.
Fry the sliced onions in the oil until deep golden and set half aside.
Add the spices, tomato, yogurt and salt to the pan and cook to a thick masala, then turn the eggs in it.
Layer the rice on top, scatter with the reserved onions and mint, cover tightly and steam on low heat for 12 minutes.
Fold together gently and serve.

title: Mushroom matar masala with roti
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the cumin, then add the ginger, garlic and ground spices.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Add the halved mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes until they release their juices.
Stir in the peas and salt and simmer for 4 minutes.
Serve with roti.

title: Malai chicken tikka with cucumber salad
steps: Mix the cream, grated cheese, yogurt, cardamom, pepper, ginger, garlic, half the lemon and most of the salt and coat the cubed chicken.
Thread onto skewers and grill at high heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Toss the cucumber, tomato and mint with the remaining lemon and salt.
Serve the tikka on the salad.

title: Kerala-style beef pepper fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Slice the beef thinly and toss with the pepper, curry powder, ginger, garlic and salt.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, add the coconut and toast for a minute.
Add the beef and stir-fry on high heat for 4 to 5 minutes until browned and just cooked.
Serve over the rice.

title: Sweet potato chaat
steps: Boil or steam the cubed sweet potato for 12 to 15 minutes until tender and let it cool slightly.
Toss with the lemon, cumin, chilli and salt.
Spoon over the yogurt and the tamarind loosened with a little water.
Top with the peanuts and coriander.

title: Rajma and paneer salad bowl
steps: Drain and rinse the kidney beans.
Dice the paneer, cucumber, tomato and onion.
Toss everything with the lemon, oil, cumin, chilli and salt.
Finish with coriander.

title: Moong dal and spinach soup with roti
steps: Simmer the mung beans with the turmeric and ginger in 900 ml of water for 25 minutes until very soft.
Stir in the chopped tomato, spinach and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Sizzle the cumin in the ghee and pour it into the soup.
Sharpen with lemon and serve with roti.

title: Tandoori cauliflower with chickpeas and mint yogurt
steps: Mix a third of the yogurt with the spices, garlic, oil, half the lemon and most of the salt.
Toss the cauliflower florets and drained chickpeas in the marinade and spread on a tray.
Roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Stir the mint, remaining lemon and a pinch of salt into the rest of the yogurt.
Serve with the mint yogurt and warm roti.

title: Kerala-style chicken and coconut stew
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Soften the onion, ginger and chilli in the coconut oil with the pepper, cinnamon and cardamom.
Add the chicken, potato, carrot, salt and 300 ml of water and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and warm through without boiling.
Serve with the rice.

title: Peanut, chickpea and mango chaat
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the mango and finely chop the onion and mint.
Toss with the peanuts, lemon, spices and salt.
Eat straight away.

title: Home-style chicken curry (meal prep)
steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the chicken, and sear for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, salt and 200 ml of water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce coats a spoon.
Cook the rice in salted water.
Divide the rice and curry between 4 containers and top with coriander; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Big-batch tarka dal with brown rice
steps: Cook the brown rice until tender.
Simmer the lentils with the turmeric, ginger and tomatoes in 1.2 litres of water for 25 minutes until creamy.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin and mustard seeds until dark golden, then stir in the chilli powder.
Pour the tarka into the dal with the salt and lemon.
Portion with the rice into 4 containers; keeps for 4 days chilled.

title: Chicken maqluba (upside-down rice)
steps: Roast the sliced aubergine and cauliflower florets with half the oil at 220 °C for 20 minutes until golden.
Brown the chicken and onion in the remaining oil with the spices.
Layer the chicken in a deep pot, then the roasted vegetables, then the rinsed rice, and pour over the hot stock with the salt.
Cover and cook on low heat for 25 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.
Turn out onto a platter and scatter with toasted almonds and parsley.

title: Baked kofta with potatoes and tomato
steps: Mix the mince with the grated onion, chopped parsley, spices and most of the salt and shape into 8 oval patties.
Arrange them in a baking dish with the sliced potatoes and tomatoes.
Pour over the passata mixed with 150 ml of water, the oil and the remaining salt.
Cover with foil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, then uncover for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender and browned.

title: Chicken livers with lemon and pomegranate
steps: Trim the livers and pat them dry.
Sear in the hot oil for 3 minutes each side until browned outside and just cooked through.
Add the garlic, cumin, pepper and salt and cook for 1 minute.
Take off the heat, pour over the lemon and scatter with pomegranate seeds and parsley.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Fasolia (white bean and lamb stew) with rice
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil, then add the onion and garlic and soften.
Stir in the tomato paste, spices, tomatoes, salt and 300 ml of water, cover and simmer for 50 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Add the drained beans and cook for 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice in salted water and serve with the stew.

title: Bamia (okra and beef stew) with rice
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, add the onion and half the garlic and soften.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, salt and 300 ml of water, cover and simmer for 55 minutes until tender.
Add the trimmed okra and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the remaining garlic, the coriander and lemon for the last 2 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with the stew.

title: Sayadieh (fish with caramelised onion rice)
steps: Cook the sliced onions slowly in most of the oil for 15 minutes until dark brown; set a third aside.
Add the cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, rinsed rice, most of the salt and 330 ml of water to the pan, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Season the fish with the remaining salt and pan-fry in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes each side.
Serve the fish on the rice topped with the reserved onions, toasted pine nuts, lemon and parsley.

title: Chicken fatteh with chickpeas and yogurt
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, then shred it.
Toast the pita until crisp and break it into pieces.
Whisk the yogurt with the tahini, crushed garlic, lemon and a pinch of salt.
Warm the chickpeas with the cumin and a splash of the poaching water.
Layer the pita, chickpeas and chicken, spoon over the yogurt and finish with toasted pine nuts, paprika and parsley.

title: Chickpea fatteh with yogurt and pine nuts
steps: Toast the pita until crisp and break it into a shallow dish.
Warm the chickpeas with the cumin and 100 ml of water for 5 minutes, then spoon them and a little of their liquid over the bread.
Whisk the yogurt with the tahini, garlic, lemon and salt and pour over.
Toast the pine nuts in the oil, pour over the top and finish with parsley.

title: Egg and spiced mince skillet with pita
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, add the mince and spices and fry until browned.
Stir in the chopped tomato and salt and cook for 2 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve with warm pita.

title: Balila (warm chickpeas with cumin and lemon)
steps: Warm the chickpeas in a small pan with 80 ml of water for 4 to 5 minutes.
Crush the garlic with the salt and stir in with the cumin and lemon.
Lightly mash a few of the chickpeas to thicken the juices.
Drizzle with the oil, scatter with parsley and serve with warm pita.

title: Stuffed courgettes with beef and rice
steps: Halve the courgettes lengthways and scoop out the centres to make boats.
Mix the mince with the rinsed rice, cinnamon, pepper and half the salt and fill the boats loosely.
Blend the tomatoes with the garlic, mint, oil, remaining salt and 250 ml of water and pour into a wide pan.
Sit the courgettes in the sauce, cover and simmer gently for 40 to 45 minutes until the rice is cooked.
Serve with the sauce spooned over.

title: Beef shawarma wrap with tahini sauce
steps: Slice the beef thinly across the grain and toss with the yogurt, vinegar, spices, garlic and most of the salt.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon, a pinch of salt and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes until browned at the edges.
Fill the warmed pitas with the beef, tomato, onion and parsley and drizzle with the tahini sauce.

title: Arayes (crisp meat-stuffed pita) with yogurt
steps: Mix the mince with the finely chopped onion, parsley, tomato, spices and salt.
Cut the pitas in half and spread a thin layer of the mixture inside each pocket.
Brush the outsides with the oil and cook in a hot pan or under the grill for 5 to 6 minutes each side until the meat is cooked and the bread is crisp.
Serve with the yogurt and cucumber.

title: Chicken and vermicelli soup with lemon
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the stock, cinnamon and whole chicken breast and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and shred it; add the broken pasta to the pot and cook for 6 minutes.
Return the chicken and season with the salt and lemon.
Finish with parsley.

title: Lentil, chard and lemon soup
steps: Simmer the lentils in 1 litre of water for 15 minutes.
Add the diced potato and cook for 10 minutes more.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin and coriander and add to the pot with the chopped chard and salt.
Cook for 8 minutes until the chard is tender, then stir in the lemon.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Maghmour (aubergine and chickpea stew)
steps: Brown the cubed aubergine in half the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil with the cumin.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, aubergine, salt and 150 ml of water and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Stir in the mint and serve warm or at room temperature with pita.

title: Batata harra (spicy potatoes) with fried eggs
steps: Par-boil the cubed potatoes for 6 minutes and drain well.
Fry them in most of the oil for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden.
Add the garlic, chilli and salt for the last minute, then toss with the coriander and lemon.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil and serve them on the potatoes.

title: Hummus with spiced lamb and pine nuts
steps: Dice the lamb very small and toss with the cinnamon, cumin and salt.
Sear in the hot oil for 4 to 5 minutes until browned, adding the pine nuts for the last minute.
Spread the hummus on two plates and pile the lamb in the centre.
Finish with lemon and parsley and serve with warm pita and sliced tomato.

title: Baked cod in tahini sauce with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Cook the sliced onion in the oil for 10 minutes until golden and spread in a baking dish.
Season the fish with the cumin, coriander, chilli and most of the salt and lay it on the onions.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon, garlic, remaining salt and 100 ml of water, pour over the fish and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Scatter with pine nuts and parsley and serve with the rice.

title: Hummus with vegetable sticks
steps: Cut the carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a small bowl.
Serve the vegetables alongside for dipping.

title: Thyme and sesame roasted chickpeas
steps: Drain the chickpeas and dry them well with a clean towel.
Toss with the oil, thyme, sesame seeds and salt and spread on a tray.
Roast at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes, shaking once, until crisp.
Squeeze over the lemon and cool before eating.

title: Cucumber and mint yogurt with walnuts
steps: Finely dice the cucumber.
Stir it into the yogurt with the crushed garlic, chopped mint and salt.
Top with the roughly chopped walnuts.

title: Ijjeh (herb and courgette omelette) with pita
steps: Grate the courgette and squeeze out the excess water.
Beat the eggs with the flour and salt, then stir in the courgette and chopped herbs and spring onion.
Pour into the hot oiled pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until set underneath.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes more, then serve with warm pita.

title: Feta, egg and olive breakfast plate
steps: Boil the egg for 9 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Slice the cucumber and tomato and arrange on a plate with the feta, olives and egg.
Drizzle with the oil and scatter with mint.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Lemon and garlic chicken with potatoes
steps: Toss the chicken and potato wedges with the crushed garlic, lemon, oil, paprika, thyme and salt in a roasting tin.
Add 100 ml of water and cover with foil.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, then uncover and roast for 20 minutes until golden and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with the pan juices and the lettuce.

title: Lahm bi ajeen (spiced lamb flatbreads)
steps: Mix the mince with the finely chopped tomato and onion, the tomato paste, parsley, spices and salt.
Spread the mixture thinly over the pitas, right to the edges.
Bake at 230 °C for 8 to 10 minutes until the meat is cooked and the edges are crisp.
Squeeze over the lemon, top with rocket and serve with the yogurt.

title: Lentil tabbouleh with feta
steps: Simmer the lentils for 18 to 20 minutes until just tender, drain and cool.
Finely chop the herbs, tomato, cucumber and spring onion.
Toss everything with the lemon, oil and salt.
Crumble the feta over the top.

title: Mansaf-style lamb with yogurt sauce and rice
steps: Simmer the lamb with the onion, cardamom, bay and half the salt in 800 ml of water for 70 minutes until tender; keep the broth.
Whisk the yogurt with the cornflour and 300 ml of the broth and heat gently, stirring constantly in one direction, until it simmers and thickens.
Add the lamb to the yogurt sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice with the turmeric, ghee and remaining salt.
Serve the lamb and sauce over the rice with toasted almonds, pine nuts and parsley.

title: Tuna and chickpea salad with tahini-lemon dressing
steps: Whisk the tahini with the lemon, salt and a spoon or two of water until creamy.
Drain the tuna and chickpeas.
Toss with the chopped cucumber, tomato, onion and parsley.
Pour over the dressing and mix.

title: Potato, egg and mint salad
steps: Boil the cubed potato for 12 minutes until tender, adding the eggs to the pan for the last 9 minutes.
Drain; peel and quarter the eggs.
Toss the warm potato with the lemon, oil, cumin and salt.
Fold in the herbs, spring onion and eggs.

title: Spinach and beef stew with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Brown the mince with the onion in the oil.
Add the garlic and coriander, then the spinach in handfuls with 150 ml of water and the salt, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the lemon and scatter with toasted pine nuts.
Serve over the rice.

title: Green beans in tomato and olive oil with bulgur
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the trimmed beans and cumin and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and most of the salt, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the beans are very tender.
Simmer the bulgur in 260 ml of salted water for 12 minutes, covered.
Serve the beans over the bulgur with the yogurt.

title: Koobideh-style beef kebabs with saffron rice
steps: Grate the onion, squeeze out the juice and knead it into the mince with the turmeric, pepper and most of the salt for 3 minutes until sticky.
Shape into 4 long flat kebabs around skewers, or on a tray.
Cook the rice in salted water, then stir in the butter and the saffron soaked in a spoon of hot water.
Grill the kebabs and halved tomatoes on high heat for 4 to 5 minutes each side.
Serve the kebabs and tomatoes on the rice.

title: Herb, kidney bean and beef stew
steps: Brown the onion and beef in half the oil with the turmeric.
Add 600 ml of water and the salt, cover and simmer for 60 minutes.
Fry the finely chopped herbs, spinach and spring onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until dark and fragrant.
Add the herbs, beans and lime juice to the pot and simmer for 30 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve with the stew.

title: Saffron chicken with cranberry and pistachio rice
steps: Soak the saffron in 2 spoons of hot water.
Brown the chicken in the oil with the onion, turmeric and most of the salt, add 150 ml of water and half the saffron, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted water, drain and toss with the remaining saffron.
Warm the cranberries and pistachios in the butter with the cinnamon for 1 minute and fold through the rice.
Serve the chicken and its juices over the rice.

title: Chicken saloona (spiced chicken and vegetable stew)
steps: Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic, ginger, spices and chicken and sear.
Stir in the tomato, tomato paste, salt and 600 ml of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes, then the courgette for 8 minutes more.
Cook the rice in salted water and serve with the stew.

title: Thareed (lamb and vegetable stew over flatbread)
steps: Brown the lamb and onion in the oil with the garlic and spices.
Add the tomato, tomato paste, salt and 800 ml of water, cover and simmer for 50 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot for 12 minutes, then the courgette for 8 minutes.
Tear the flatbread into a wide dish.
Ladle the stew and its broth over the bread and leave for 3 minutes to soak before serving.

title: Madrouba (soft spiced chicken and rice)
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in half the ghee with the spices.
Add the tomato, chicken, rinsed rice, stock, salt and 700 ml of water.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice has broken down.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and beat it back into the rice with a wooden spoon until thick and smooth.
Top with the remaining ghee.

title: Fish machboos
steps: Rub the fish with half the spices, the lemon and half the salt and sear in half the oil for 2 minutes each side; set aside.
Brown the onion in the remaining oil with the garlic and the rest of the spices.
Add the tomato, rinsed rice, remaining salt and 320 ml of water, cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Lay the fish on the rice, cover and steam for 6 minutes more.
Serve the fish on the rice.

title: Shuwa-style slow-roast lamb with rice
steps: Blend the garlic, spices, vinegar, oil and most of the salt to a paste and rub it all over the lamb.
Wrap tightly in baking paper and foil and roast at 160 °C for 3 hours until it pulls apart.
Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Shred the lamb into its juices.
Serve on the rice with the cucumber and yogurt.

title: Dango (warm spiced chickpeas)
steps: Simmer the chickpeas in 150 ml of water with the chilli and salt for 8 minutes.
Drain off most of the liquid.
Toss with the oil, cumin and lemon and serve warm in cups.

title: Chebab (cardamom pancakes) with dates and yogurt
steps: Whisk the flour, egg, milk, cardamom and saffron to a smooth batter and rest for 5 minutes.
Cook 3 small pancakes in the butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Chop the dates and mash them with a spoon of hot water into a rough syrup.
Serve the pancakes with the yogurt and dates.

title: Egg and cheese regag-style wrap
steps: Beat the eggs with the pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan, pour in the egg and lay the flatbread on top while it is still wet.
Flip after 1 minute, scatter the cheese over the egg and cook for 1 minute more.
Fold in half and eat warm.

title: Date and cardamom porridge with pistachios
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk and cardamom for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in the chopped dates.
Top with the chopped pistachios.

title: Dates stuffed with strained yogurt and almonds
steps: Slit the dates and remove the stones.
Fill each with a spoon of the strained yogurt.
Press an almond into each one.

title: Grilled prawn skewers with lemon rice
steps: Toss the prawns with the garlic, paprika, cumin, oil, half the lemon and half the salt and thread onto skewers.
Cook the rice with the turmeric and remaining salt until tender, then fork through the rest of the lemon and the parsley.
Grill the skewers on high heat for 2 to 3 minutes each side until pink.
Serve on the rice.

title: Mumawwash (prawn and mung bean rice)
steps: Simmer the mung beans for 15 minutes until half cooked and drain.
Brown the onion in the oil with the garlic and spices, then stir in the tomato.
Add the rice, mung beans, salt and 350 ml of water, cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Scatter the prawns on top, cover and steam for 6 minutes until pink.
Fold together and serve.

title: Cumin sea bass with chickpea salad
steps: Rub the fish with the cumin, garlic, half the oil, a third of the lemon and half the salt.
Bake at 200 °C for 10 to 12 minutes until the flesh flakes.
Toss the drained chickpeas with the chopped cucumber, tomato, onion and parsley and dress with the remaining lemon, oil and salt.
Serve the fish on the salad.

title: Chicken and oat soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the diced chicken and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the tomato and tomato paste.
Pour in the stock and 200 ml of water, add the oats and simmer for 15 minutes until thick and silky.
Season with the salt and lemon and finish with parsley.

title: Tuna rice with daqoos tomato sauce
steps: Cook the rice with the turmeric and half the salt until tender.
Soften half the onion in half the oil and stir through the rice with the drained tuna.
For the daqoos, fry the remaining onion and the garlic in the rest of the oil, add the tomato, tomato paste, chilli, cumin, coriander and remaining salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the rice with the sauce spooned over.

title: Goat mandi
steps: Rub the goat with half the spices and half the salt.
Simmer it with the onion in 900 ml of water, covered, for 75 minutes until tender; keep the broth.
Brown the meat under a hot grill for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice in 450 ml of the broth with the remaining spices and salt for 15 minutes.
Fry the raisins and almonds in the ghee and scatter over the rice and meat.

title: Chickpea and spinach machboos with yogurt
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the garlic and spices.
Add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the chickpeas and rinsed rice.
Pour in 320 ml of water with the salt, cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Pile the spinach on top, cover again and steam for 5 minutes, then fold through.
Serve with the yogurt.

title: Karak-spiced protein shake
steps: Put the milk, whey, spices and honey in a shaker or blender.
Shake or blend until smooth.
Serve cold, or warm gently without boiling.

title: Tahini and date shake
steps: Remove the stones from the dates.
Blend everything until completely smooth.
Serve cold.

title: Tamarind fish curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomato, and cook until soft.
Stir in the tamarind loosened in 250 ml of water and the salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish pieces and poach gently for 7 to 8 minutes.
Finish with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Spiced crab and pea rice
steps: Brown the onion in the oil with the garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes, then the rinsed rice, salt and 300 ml of water.
Cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Fold in the peas and drained crab, cover and steam for 4 minutes.
Finish with the lemon.

title: Chicken, pomegranate and mint salad
steps: Season the chicken with the cumin and half the salt and grill for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Chop the lettuce, cucumber and mint and toss with the chickpeas.
Dress with the lemon, oil and remaining salt.
Slice the chicken over the salad and scatter with pomegranate seeds and walnuts.

title: Chicken, olive and lemon tagine
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the ginger, turmeric, cumin and saffron.
Add the chicken and turn it in the spices, then add the potato chunks, salt and 300 ml of water.
Cover and simmer for 35 minutes until the chicken and potatoes are tender.
Stir in the olives and lemon and cook uncovered for 5 minutes to reduce the sauce.
Finish with parsley and coriander.

title: Lamb and fig tagine with couscous
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil, then add the onion and spices and soften.
Pour in the stock and 200 ml of water with the salt, cover and simmer for 60 minutes.
Add the halved figs and honey and cook uncovered for 15 minutes until the sauce is glossy.
Pour 150 ml of boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Serve the tagine on the couscous with toasted almonds.

title: Tunisian-style tuna and egg wrap
steps: Scatter the drained tuna and parsley over one half of the tortilla and make a hollow in the middle.
Crack the egg into the hollow, dust with chilli and fold the tortilla over, pressing the edges.
Slide into the hot oiled pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes each side until crisp and the egg is set.
Squeeze over the lemon.

title: Ojja (Tunisian eggs with prawns and peppers)
steps: Soften the sliced pepper and garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the prawns, then make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the prawns are pink and the egg whites are set.
Serve with the bread.

title: Lablabi (Tunisian chickpea soup)
steps: Simmer the chickpeas with the garlic, cumin, chilli, stock and salt for 15 minutes.
Soft-boil the eggs for 6 minutes and peel.
Tear the bread into two deep bowls.
Ladle the chickpeas and broth over the bread and top each with an egg.
Finish with the lemon and oil.

title: Mechouia salad with tuna and egg
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and quarter.
Chop the drained peppers and the tomato finely with the garlic until almost a relish.
Season with the cumin, lemon, oil and salt.
Top with the tuna, eggs and olives and serve with the bread.

title: Bessara (fava bean soup) with pita
steps: Simmer the drained beans with the garlic and 250 ml of water for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth with the cumin, lemon, salt and two-thirds of the oil.
Reheat gently, loosening with water if needed.
Drizzle with the remaining oil, dust with paprika and serve with warm pita.

title: Lighter macarona béchamel
steps: Boil the pasta until just tender and drain.
Brown the mince with the onion, add the passata and half the salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick; season with the nutmeg and remaining salt.
Layer half the pasta, all the meat, then the rest of the pasta in a dish and pour over the sauce.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Moroccan chicken couscous salad (meal prep)
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, half the oil and half the salt and roast at 200 °C with the diced courgette and pepper for 18 to 20 minutes.
Pour 250 ml of boiling water over the couscous and raisins, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Dice the chicken and fold it into the couscous with the vegetables and chickpeas.
Dress with the lemon, remaining oil and salt and the herbs.
Divide between 4 containers; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Loubia (Moroccan white beans in tomato)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the drained beans with 100 ml of water and cook for 10 minutes until thick and saucy.
Finish with parsley and serve with the bread.

title: Berber-style tomato omelette
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, add the chopped tomato, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for 6 minutes to a thick sauce.
Pour the beaten eggs over the sauce.
Cover and cook on low heat for 4 minutes until just set.
Scatter with parsley and serve from the pan with the bread.

title: Semolina pancakes with honey and yogurt
steps: Whisk the semolina, flour and warm milk to a thin batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Cook 3 pancakes in a lightly buttered pan over medium heat, on one side only, until the tops are set and full of holes.
Warm the honey with the remaining butter.
Serve the pancakes with the honey butter and yogurt.

title: Chorba (lamb, chickpea and bulgur soup)
steps: Brown the diced lamb in the oil with the onion, celery and spices.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and 800 ml of water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the bulgur and chickpeas and cook for 15 minutes more.
Finish with the coriander and mint.

title: Merguez-spiced turkey meatballs with couscous
steps: Mix the mince with the spices, garlic and most of the salt and roll into 12 meatballs.
Pan-fry in the oil for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Pour 150 ml of boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with the lemon.
Stir the grated cucumber, mint and a pinch of salt into the yogurt.
Serve the meatballs on the couscous with the yogurt.

title: Orange, cinnamon and almond yogurt
steps: Peel the orange and slice it into rounds.
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and arrange the orange on top.
Dust with cinnamon, drizzle with honey and scatter with chopped almonds.

title: Sweet potato and chickpea tagine with couscous
steps: Soften the onion in the oil with the spices.
Add the cubed sweet potato, tomatoes, chopped apricots, salt and 250 ml of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce is thick.
Pour 150 ml of boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Serve the tagine over the couscous.

title: Menemen (Turkish eggs with tomato and pepper)
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato, paprika and salt and cook for 4 minutes until saucy.
Pour in the lightly beaten eggs and stir gently until just set and still soft.
Serve from the pan with the bread.

title: Turkish kofte with white bean salad
steps: Knead the mince with half the onion (grated), half the parsley, the cumin, breadcrumbs and most of the salt, and shape into 8 small flat patties.
Grill or pan-fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Toss the drained beans with the sliced remaining onion, tomato, parsley, lemon, oil, vinegar and remaining salt.
Serve the kofte on the bean salad.

title: Imam bayildi with bulgur and yogurt
steps: Halve the aubergines, score the flesh, brush with a little of the oil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the onion and garlic in the remaining oil until soft, add the chopped tomato and most of the salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Spoon the filling over the aubergines and bake for 15 minutes more.
Simmer the bulgur in 240 ml of salted water for 12 minutes, covered.
Serve the aubergines on the bulgur with the yogurt and parsley.

title: Greek chicken and pasta bake (youvetsi)
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in an ovenproof pan and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, then add the passata, stock, cinnamon, oregano, salt and 150 ml of water and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the small pasta (orzo or broken spaghetti) and sit the chicken on top.
Bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes, stirring once, until the pasta is tender and has absorbed the sauce.
Crumble over the feta.

title: Lighter moussaka with yogurt topping
steps: Brush the sliced aubergine and potato with the oil and bake at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Brown the mince with the onion and garlic, add the passata, cinnamon, oregano and most of the salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the potato, half the aubergine, the meat and the remaining aubergine in a dish.
Whisk the yogurt, egg, cheese and remaining salt and spread over the top.
Bake at 190 °C for 25 to 30 minutes until golden and set.

title: Spanakorizo (spinach rice) with feta and egg
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, then stir in the rice for a minute.
Add 300 ml of water and the salt, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and dill, cover and cook for 6 minutes more until the rice is tender.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Stir the lemon into the rice and serve topped with the feta and eggs.

title: Briam (Greek roast vegetables) with chickpeas and feta
steps: Slice all the vegetables to the same thickness and toss with the tomatoes, oil, oregano and salt in a roasting tin.
Cover with foil and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and roast uncovered for 20 minutes until the edges caramelise.
Crumble over the feta.

title: Grilled squid salad with lemon and rocket
steps: Score the squid and toss it with the garlic, a third of the oil and half the salt.
Sear on a very hot griddle for 1 to 2 minutes each side until just opaque; any longer and it turns rubbery.
Toss the rocket, tomato, cucumber, olives and parsley with the lemon and remaining oil and salt.
Pile the squid on the salad and serve with the bread.

title: Mussels in tomato and garlic with bread
steps: Scrub the mussels and discard any that stay open when tapped (the weight given is for cleaned mussel meat; allow about 1.5 kg in the shell).
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the chilli, add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the mussels, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they open; discard any that stay shut.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.

title: Trout with almonds, green beans and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes.
Season the trout with half the salt and pan-fry in half the butter, skin side down, for 3 minutes, then turn for 2 minutes.
Toast the flaked almonds in the remaining butter and add the lemon.
Serve the fish with the vegetables and spoon over the almond butter and parsley.

title: Garlic prawns with white beans and spinach
steps: Warm the oil with the sliced garlic, paprika and chilli until it sizzles.
Add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes each side until pink.
Stir in the drained beans, spinach and salt and heat for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Finish with lemon and parsley.

title: Pisto (Spanish vegetable stew) with fried eggs
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in most of the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the diced courgette and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Serve the pisto topped with the eggs, with the bread.

title: Spanish chicken and chickpea stew
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, pepper and garlic, then stir in the paprika.
Add the tomatoes, stock, chickpeas, salt and the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve in bowls.

title: Fakes (Greek lentil soup) with feta
steps: Simmer the lentils with the carrot, onion, garlic, bay leaf and tomato paste in 900 ml of water for 30 minutes until soft.
Season with the salt and stir in the vinegar and oil.
Ladle into bowls and crumble over the feta.
Serve with the bread.

title: Artichoke, chickpea and feta salad
steps: Quarter the cooked artichoke hearts and slice the sun-dried tomatoes.
Toss with the drained chickpeas and rocket.
Dress with the lemon and oil.
Crumble the feta over the top.

title: Fennel, orange and chicken salad with quinoa
steps: Simmer the quinoa for 12 minutes, drain and cool.
Season the chicken with half the salt and grill for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Shave the fennel thinly and cut the orange into segments.
Toss the fennel, orange, rocket, olives and quinoa with the oil, lemon and remaining salt.
Slice the chicken over the top.

title: Grilled chicken with watermelon, feta and mint
steps: Season the chicken with the salt and pepper and grill for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Cube the watermelon and cucumber and toss with the lime, oil and torn mint.
Crumble over the feta.
Slice the chicken and serve it on the salad.

title: Roasted pepper, goat cheese and lentil salad
steps: Simmer the lentils for 18 to 20 minutes until just tender and drain.
Toss them while warm with the vinegar, oil and salt.
Fold in the sliced peppers and rocket.
Top with the crumbled goat cheese and walnuts.

title: Greek yogurt with peach and pistachios
steps: Slice the peach.
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with the fruit.
Scatter with the chopped pistachios and drizzle with honey.

title: Chicken keftedes with tzatziki and tomato salad
steps: Mix the mince with the oats, egg, mint, oregano, half the garlic and most of the salt and roll into 12 balls.
Bake at 210 °C for 15 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stir the grated cucumber and remaining garlic into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Dress the sliced tomato with the oil.
Serve the keftedes with the tzatziki, tomato and warm pita.

title: Baked feta with tomatoes and chickpeas
steps: Tip the drained chickpeas, halved tomatoes and garlic into a baking dish and toss with the oil and oregano.
Sit the feta in the middle and bake at 200 °C for 22 to 25 minutes until the tomatoes burst and the feta is soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, breaking up the feta into a sauce.
Serve with the bread.

title: Lemon-garlic chicken with herby bulgur (meal prep)
steps: Coat the chicken with the garlic, oregano, half the lemon, a third of the oil and half the salt.
Bake at 200 °C for 18 to 20 minutes until cooked through, then slice.
Pour 480 ml of boiling water over the bulgur, cover for 15 minutes and fluff.
Fold the diced cucumber, tomato and parsley through the bulgur with the remaining lemon, oil and salt.
Divide between 4 containers with the chicken; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Salmon with mustard lentils and spinach
steps: Simmer the lentils with the thyme for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Soften the shallot in half the oil, add the lentils, mustard, vinegar, spinach and most of the salt and stir until the spinach wilts.
Season the salmon with the remaining salt and pan-fry in the rest of the oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes, then turn for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve the salmon on the lentils.

title: Tuna, tomato and olive spaghetti
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until just tender.
Warm the garlic and chilli in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and sliced olives and heat through.
Toss with the drained pasta and a splash of its cooking water and finish with parsley.

title: Pasta alla norma with ricotta
steps: Toss the cubed aubergine with most of the oil and half the salt and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes until golden.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, remaining oil and salt for 10 minutes.
Boil the pasta until just tender and drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and aubergine and top with spoonfuls of ricotta and torn basil.

title: Lemon chicken piccata-style with green beans and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes.
Slice the chicken into thin escalopes, season with the salt and dust with the flour.
Pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and set aside.
Add the stock and lemon to the pan, bubble for 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter and parsley.
Return the chicken to coat and serve with the vegetables.

title: Turkey meatball, white bean and kale soup
steps: Mix the mince with the breadcrumbs, half the cheese and half the salt and roll into small meatballs.
Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the stock and 300 ml of water, bring to a simmer and drop in the meatballs; cook for 10 minutes.
Add the beans, kale and remaining salt and simmer for 6 minutes.
Serve with the rest of the cheese.

title: Soft polenta with mushroom and white bean ragù
steps: Brown the sliced mushrooms in the oil, then add the onion, garlic and thyme and soften.
Add the tomatoes, beans and half the salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Whisk the cornmeal into 600 ml of simmering water with the remaining salt and cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes until thick.
Stir most of the cheese into the polenta.
Serve the ragù over the polenta with the remaining cheese.

title: Slow-cooked beef ragù with pasta (meal prep)
steps: Brown the beef in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, stock, bay, thyme and salt, cover and simmer very gently for 2 hours until it falls apart.
Shred the beef into the sauce with two forks.
Boil the pasta and toss with the ragù; the sauce keeps for 4 days chilled or 3 months frozen.

title: Caprese chicken tray bake
steps: Toss the cubed potatoes with half the oil and half the salt and roast at 210 °C for 12 minutes.
Add the chicken and halved tomatoes to the tray, drizzle with the remaining oil and salt and roast for 12 minutes.
