Lay the sliced mozzarella on the chicken and return to the oven for 5 minutes until melted and the chicken is cooked through.
Finish with the vinegar and basil.

title: Ricotta, lemon and courgette pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Fry the grated courgette and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Stir the ricotta, lemon and cheese together with a ladle of the pasta water.
Toss the drained pasta and peas with the courgette and ricotta sauce.

title: Egg, spinach and parmesan breakfast wrap
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil.
Add the beaten eggs and pepper and scramble softly.
Warm the flatbread in a dry pan.
Fill with the eggs, grate over the cheese and fold.

title: Creamy chicken and sun-dried tomato pasta
steps: Boil the pasta until just tender.
Brown the sliced chicken in the oil for 6 minutes with the salt.
Add the garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes, then stir in the cream cheese and milk to make a sauce.
Add the spinach and drained pasta and toss until glossy.
Finish with the cheese and basil.

title: Seafood and fennel stew
steps: Soften the sliced fennel, onion and garlic in the oil with the chilli for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, salt and 250 ml of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cod chunks and cook for 3 minutes, then the prawns and mussel meat for 3 minutes more until everything is just cooked.
Serve in bowls with the bread.

title: Turkey and wild rice soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms in the oil.
Add the stock, wild rice, thyme and 400 ml of water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the diced turkey and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until the rice has split and the turkey is cooked through.
Stir in the milk and salt and warm through without boiling.

title: Turkey, Swiss and sauerkraut rye melt
steps: Spread the bread with the mustard.
Layer on the turkey, well-drained sauerkraut and cheese and close the sandwich.
Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, pressing down, until the cheese melts.

title: Peanut butter and jam toast with milk
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with the peanut butter, then the jam.
Serve with the glass of milk.

title: Turkey burgers in lettuce with sweet potato wedges
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with most of the oil, the paprika and half the salt and roast at 220 °C for 25 to 30 minutes.
Mix the mince with the grated onion, garlic powder and remaining salt and shape into 4 patties.
Pan-fry in the remaining oil for 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Serve the burgers in lettuce leaves with tomato and mustard, with the wedges alongside.

title: Beef and bean chilli mac (meal prep)
steps: Brown the mince with the onion in a large pot.
Stir in the spices, then add the tomatoes, stock, salt and 400 ml of water and bring to the boil.
Add the pasta and beans and simmer for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Portion into 4 containers; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Cajun chicken and rice skillet
steps: Toss the chicken with the paprika, cayenne, thyme, oregano and half the salt and brown it in the oil.
Add the onion, peppers, celery and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, remaining salt and 250 ml of water.
Cover and cook on low heat for 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.

title: Honey mustard chicken with roasted vegetables
steps: Toss the cubed potato and carrot with the oil and half the salt and roast at 210 °C for 12 minutes.
Coat the chicken with the honey, mustard and remaining salt.
Add the chicken and broccoli to the tray and roast for 16 to 18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Spoon the pan juices over to serve.

title: Yogurt chicken salad sandwich with grapes
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes, then cool and dice.
Mix with the yogurt, mustard, chopped celery, halved grapes, walnuts and salt.
Pile onto the bread with the lettuce.

title: Turkey, potato and egg breakfast skillet
steps: Fry the diced potato in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the mince, onion, pepper, paprika and salt and cook for 6 minutes until the turkey is browned.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.

title: Cottage cheese pancakes with strawberries
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, oats and eggs to a smooth batter.
Cook 3 or 4 small pancakes in the lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Top with the sliced strawberries and honey.

title: Loaded sweet potato with black beans and yogurt
steps: Prick the sweet potato and bake at 200 °C for 45 minutes, or microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft.
Warm the drained beans with the salsa.
Split the potato and fill with the beans.
Top with the yogurt, cheese, spring onion and lime.

title: Lemon pepper cod with rice and broccoli (meal prep)
steps: Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Lay the cod and broccoli on a lined tray, drizzle with the oil and lemon and season with the pepper, garlic powder and salt.
Bake at 200 °C for 12 to 14 minutes until the fish flakes.
Divide the rice, fish and broccoli between 4 containers; keeps for 2 days chilled.

title: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the stock, thyme, 300 ml of water and the whole chicken breasts and simmer for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and shred it; add the noodles to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, season with the salt and finish with parsley.

title: Prawns with cheesy cornmeal grits
steps: Whisk the cornmeal into the simmering milk with 300 ml of water and most of the salt and cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes until thick.
Stir in the cheese.
Toss the prawns with the paprika and remaining salt and fry in the butter with the garlic for 2 minutes each side.
Spoon the prawns over the grits and finish with lemon and spring onion.

title: Paprika popcorn with almonds
steps: Air-pop the corn, or warm ready-popped plain popcorn.
Toss with the oil, paprika and salt while warm.
Mix in the almonds.

title: Chocolate protein mug cake
steps: Mash the banana in a large mug and beat in the egg and milk.
Stir in the whey, oats and cocoa until smooth.
Microwave on high for 70 to 90 seconds until risen and just set.
Rest for a minute before eating.

title: Turkey and hummus snack box
steps: Cut the carrot and cucumber into sticks.
Roll up the turkey slices.
Pack everything into a box with the hummus and rice cakes.

title: Tuna and avocado rice cakes
steps: Mash the avocado with the lemon and pepper.
Spread it over the rice cakes.
Top with the drained tuna.

title: Mulligatawny soup with chicken
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and diced apple in the oil, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the stock, lentils, rice, 300 ml of water and the whole chicken breast and simmer for 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Stir in the coconut milk and salt, return the chicken and simmer for 3 minutes.

title: Roast chicken thighs with Brussels sprouts and potatoes
steps: Toss the cubed potatoes with half the oil and half the salt and roast at 210 °C for 15 minutes.
Coat the chicken with the mustard, thyme, garlic and remaining salt.
Add the chicken and halved sprouts to the tray with the remaining oil.
Roast for 22 to 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sprouts are browned.

title: Crispy baked cod wraps with red cabbage slaw
steps: Cut the cod into fingers, dip in the beaten egg and coat in the breadcrumbs mixed with the paprika and half the salt.
Place on an oiled tray, drizzle with the oil and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 14 minutes until crisp.
Toss the finely shredded cabbage with the yogurt, lime and remaining salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the slaw and fish.

title: Egg and watercress sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Mash with the yogurt, mustard, pepper and salt.
Spread over one slice of bread, top with the watercress and close the sandwich.

title: Spiced pumpkin and red lentil soup
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil with the cumin.
Add the cubed pumpkin, lentils, stock and 200 ml of water and simmer for 22 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth and stir in the coconut milk and salt.
Top with the toasted pumpkin seeds and serve with the bread.

title: Blackberry and flaxseed porridge
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in the ground flaxseed.
Top with the blackberries and honey.

title: Cottage cheese with grapes and walnuts on rye
steps: Toast the rye bread if you like.
Spoon over the cottage cheese.
Top with the halved grapes and chopped walnuts.

title: Liver and onions with mash and peas
steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes, drain and mash with the milk, butter and half the salt.
Cook the sliced onions in half the oil for 12 minutes until soft and golden, then remove.
Dust the sliced liver with the flour and remaining salt and fry in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes each side.
Return the onions, pour in the stock and bubble for 3 minutes to make a gravy.
Boil the peas and serve everything together.

title: Chicken tikka naan pizza
steps: Dice the chicken small and toss with the yogurt, paprika, cumin and salt.
Fry in a hot non-stick pan for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Spread the naans with the tomato paste and top with the chicken, sliced onion and cheese.
Bake at 220 °C for 6 to 7 minutes until the cheese bubbles, then scatter with coriander.

title: Chicken, leek and barley stew
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Soften the leek, carrot and celery in the same pot.
Add the barley, stock, thyme, bay, salt, 300 ml of water and the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 40 minutes until the barley is tender.
Finish with parsley.

title: Tuna and sweetcorn pasta bake
steps: Boil the pasta until just tender and drain.
Whisk the cornflour into the cold milk, bring to a simmer, stirring, until thickened, then add the mustard, salt and half the cheese.
Fold in the pasta, drained tuna, sweetcorn and spring onion and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheese and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Bubble and squeak with poached eggs
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the shredded cabbage and sprouts for the last 4 minutes; drain well and roughly mash with the salt.
Mix in the spring onion.
Fry the mixture in the butter and oil, pressing it flat, for 4 to 5 minutes each side until crusty.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes and serve on top.

title: Coronation-style chicken salad on wholemeal
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes, cool and shred.
Mix the yogurt with the curry powder, salt and finely diced mango.
Fold in the chicken and raisins.
Serve on the bread with the lettuce, scattered with the almonds.

title: Beef and root vegetable stew
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in the oil.
Add the onion and celery and soften, then stir in the tomato paste.
Pour in the stock and Worcestershire sauce with the thyme, bay and salt, cover and simmer for 75 minutes.
Add the potato, carrot and turnip and cook for 35 to 40 minutes more until everything is tender.

title: Chicken tinga tostadas
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes and shred it.
Soften the onion and garlic in a dry non-stick pan, add the tomatoes, paprika, chilli, oregano and salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and cook until the sauce clings.
Bake the tortillas at 200 °C for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp.
Top the tostadas with the chicken, lettuce, avocado and yogurt.

title: Black bean soup with lime and yogurt
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin and chilli.
Add the beans with their liquid, the stock and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in.
Toast the tortillas and cut into strips.
Stir in the lime and serve topped with the yogurt, coriander and tortilla strips.

title: Baked chilaquiles with eggs and black beans
steps: Cut the tortillas into wedges, toss with the oil and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Warm the salsa with the drained beans in a wide pan.
Fold in the tortilla chips so they are just coated.
Fry or poach the eggs and place on top.
Finish with the crumbled cheese, onion and coriander.

title: Prawn, mango and avocado salad
steps: Poach the prawns in simmering water for 2 to 3 minutes until pink, then drain and cool.
Dice the mango, avocado, cucumber, onion and jalapeño.
Toss with the prawns, lime, coriander and salt.
Serve on the lettuce with the toasted tortillas.

title: Pollo asado with rice and beans (meal prep)
steps: Squeeze the orange and mix the juice with the lime, garlic, cumin, oregano, paprika, oil and most of the salt; coat the chicken and rest for 15 minutes.
Roast at 220 °C for 22 to 25 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through, then slice.
Cook the rice in salted water until tender.
Warm the beans with a pinch of cumin.
Divide the rice, beans and chicken between 4 containers; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Albondigas (Mexican meatball soup)
steps: Mix the mince with the raw rice, egg, chopped mint, cumin and half the salt and roll into small meatballs.
Bring the stock, tomatoes, onion, remaining salt and 300 ml of water to a simmer.
Add the meatballs, carrot and potato and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the courgette and cook for 8 minutes more until the rice inside the meatballs is tender.

title: Bean and cheese molletes with pico de gallo
steps: Mash the drained beans with the cumin and half the salt and spread over the bread.
Top with the cheese and grill for 5 to 6 minutes until bubbling.
Mix the diced tomato, onion, jalapeño, coriander, lime and remaining salt.
Spoon the pico de gallo over the molletes.

title: Steak fajita salad
steps: Rub the steak with the cumin, paprika and most of the salt and sear for 2 to 3 minutes each side; rest for 5 minutes.
Stir-fry the sliced peppers and onion in the oil for 5 minutes until charred at the edges.
Slice the steak thinly across the grain.
Pile the lettuce with the vegetables, steak, avocado and salsa and squeeze over the lime.

title: Mexican rice and beans with fried eggs
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil, add the rice, tomato paste and cumin and stir for a minute.
Add 260 ml of water and the salt, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Fold in the drained beans and warm through.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Serve the rice topped with the eggs and salsa.

title: Cottage cheese and salsa dip with baked tortilla chips
steps: Cut the tortillas into wedges and bake at 200 °C for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp.
Stir the salsa and lime into the cottage cheese.
Serve the dip with the chips.

title: Sriracha honey chicken rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice until tender and steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Brown the diced chicken in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Add the garlic, sriracha, honey and soy sauce and bubble for 2 minutes until sticky.
Serve over the rice with the broccoli and sesame seeds.

title: Kung pao-style chicken with peanuts
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Toss the diced chicken with the cornflour and half the soy sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken in the hot oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, chilli and pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the remaining soy sauce, the vinegar and sugar and toss until glossy.
Stir in the peanuts and spring onion and serve with the rice.

title: Steamed sea bass with ginger and spring onion
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Lay the fish on a plate, scatter with half the ginger and steam over simmering water for 8 to 10 minutes until it flakes.
Steam the pak choi alongside for the last 3 minutes.
Top the fish with the remaining ginger and the spring onion, pour over the soy sauce and the sesame oil heated until just smoking.
Serve with the rice and greens.

title: Teriyaki chicken noodles
steps: Boil the noodles until just tender and drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, teriyaki and Worcestershire sauce and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.

title: Bibimbap-style beef and vegetable rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Brown the mince with the garlic and half the soy sauce.
Quickly stir-fry the carrot, courgette, bean sprouts and spinach one after another in a little of the sesame oil, keeping them in separate piles.
Fry the eggs.
Top the rice with the beef, vegetables and an egg and dress with the remaining soy sauce, sesame oil and the sriracha.

title: Chicken and ginger congee
steps: Simmer the rinsed rice with the stock, ginger and 500 ml of water for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until it breaks down into a porridge.
Add the whole chicken breast for the last 15 minutes, then lift it out and shred it.
Soft-boil the eggs for 6 minutes and peel.
Serve the congee topped with the chicken, egg, spring onion, soy sauce and sesame oil.

title: Rolled omelette with rice and edamame
steps: Cook the rice until tender and boil the edamame for 3 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the soy sauce and sugar.
Pour a third into the oiled pan, roll it up when just set, push it to one side and repeat twice more, rolling each layer around the last.
Slice the omelette and serve with the rice, edamame and torn nori.

title: Sichuan-style green beans with turkey mince
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Fry the trimmed beans in the hot oil for 5 to 6 minutes until blistered, then remove.
Brown the mince in the same pan with the garlic, ginger and chilli.
Return the beans with the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss for a minute.
Serve with the rice.

title: Prawn and vegetable fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray and cool it; day-old rice works best.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the prawns and garlic in the remaining oil for 2 minutes, then add the mixed vegetables for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in the eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Korean-style spicy chicken with cabbage and sweet potato
steps: Mix the sriracha, soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger and coat the diced chicken.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced sweet potato in the sesame oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and onion and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the cabbage and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until everything is tender and glazed.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

title: Miso-glazed cod with soba and greens
steps: Mix the miso and honey and spread over the cod.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes until caramelised and the fish flakes.
Boil the soba for 4 to 5 minutes, adding the pak choi for the last minute, then drain.
Toss the noodles and greens with the sesame oil, ginger and spring onion and top with the cod.

title: Teriyaki tofu rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice until tender and steam the broccoli and sliced carrot for 4 minutes.
Press the tofu dry, cube it and pan-fry in the oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Add the teriyaki sauce and toss for a minute until glazed.
Serve over the rice with the vegetables, sesame seeds and spring onion.

title: Tuna and nori rice balls
steps: Cook the rice until soft and sticky and let it cool until you can handle it.
Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise and soy sauce.
With wet hands, press half the rice flat, add half the tuna and shape the rice around it; repeat.
Wrap each ball in a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Chicken adobo with rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, crushed garlic, bay, pepper, sugar and 150 ml of water.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, then uncover and reduce for 8 minutes until the sauce is glossy.
Cook the rice and steam the pak choi.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice with the greens.

title: Rendang-style beef and coconut curry
steps: Blend the onion, garlic, ginger and ground spices to a paste and fry it in a dry heavy pot for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and turn to coat, then pour in the coconut milk, 250 ml of water and the salt.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for about 2 hours, stirring more often towards the end, until the sauce is dark and almost dry.
Toast the coconut and stir it in with the lime.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry.

title: Vietnamese caramel fish with rice
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Melt the sugar in the oil over medium heat until it turns amber, then add the shallot, garlic and ginger.
Add the fish sauce, pepper and 100 ml of water, then slide in the fish pieces.
Simmer for 10 minutes, turning once, until the sauce is syrupy.
Serve with the rice and sliced cucumber.

title: Gado-gado with tofu, egg and peanut sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes and the eggs for 9 minutes; blanch the beans, cabbage and bean sprouts for 2 minutes.
Pan-fry the cubed tofu in the oil until golden.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime, sugar, garlic and enough warm water to make a pourable sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu, cucumber and halved eggs on plates and pour over the sauce.

title: Thai beef salad with rice noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse.
Sear the steak for 2 to 3 minutes each side, rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Whisk the lime, fish sauce, sugar and chilli.
Toss the noodles, sliced vegetables and herbs with the dressing and top with the beef.

title: Singapore-style noodles with prawns and egg
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the prawns, garlic and pepper in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the noodles, bean sprouts and soy sauce and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Fold in the egg and spring onion.

title: Hainanese-style chicken rice
steps: Poach the chicken with half the ginger in the stock and 300 ml of water for 18 minutes; keep the broth.
Fry the garlic and the rest of the ginger in the sesame oil, stir in the rinsed rice, then add 320 ml of the broth and the salt.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken and serve on the rice with the cucumber, spring onion, soy sauce and a small bowl of the remaining broth.

title: Crispy tempeh with tomato sambal and rice
steps: Cook the rice until tender and steam the beans for 4 minutes.
Slice the tempeh and pan-fry in most of the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp, then splash with the soy sauce.
Soften the shallot and garlic in the remaining oil, add the chopped tomato and chilli and cook for 6 minutes to a chunky sambal, then add the lime.
Serve the tempeh on the rice with the sambal, beans and cucumber.

title: Thai-style omelette over rice
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Beat the eggs hard with the fish sauce and spring onion until frothy.
Pour into the very hot oil and cook for 1 to 2 minutes each side until puffed and golden at the edges.
Slide over the rice and serve with the cucumber and sriracha.

title: Prawn summer roll bowl with peanut-lime dressing
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Poach the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter with the lime, fish sauce, honey and a little warm water.
Divide the noodles, shredded vegetables, herbs and prawns between bowls and pour over the dressing.

title: Cherry and almond overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a jar.
Stone and halve the cherries and add them on top.
Chill overnight.
Scatter with the chopped almonds before eating.

title: Chocolate hazelnut protein oats
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk and cocoa for 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Take off the heat and stir in the whey with a splash of water.
Top with the sliced banana and chopped hazelnuts.

title: Berry and almond milk protein smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend for a minute until completely smooth.
Serve straight away.

title: Tropical fruit and seed yogurt bowl
steps: Peel and dice the kiwi, papaya and melon.
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with the fruit.
Scatter with the sunflower seeds and drizzle with honey.

title: Millet porridge with banana and peanut butter
steps: Rinse the millet and simmer it with the milk, cinnamon and 100 ml of water for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and creamy.
Slice the banana over the top.
Add the peanut butter and let it melt in.

title: Tuna, egg and potato salad jars (meal prep)
steps: Boil the cubed potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes; drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and quarter.
Whisk the yogurt, mustard, lemon, oil and salt.
Toss the potatoes, beans and spring onion with the dressing and divide between 4 jars.
Top with the drained tuna and eggs; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Chicken, chickpea and vegetable traybake (meal prep)
steps: Toss the chicken, drained chickpeas and chunky vegetables with the paprika, cumin, oil and salt on a large tray.
Roast at 210 °C for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are charred at the edges.
Squeeze over the lemon.
Divide between 4 containers; keeps for 3 days chilled.

title: Banana and peanut butter baked oats (meal prep)
steps: Mash the bananas and whisk in the eggs, milk, peanut butter, cinnamon and whey.
Stir in the oats and pour into a lined baking dish.
Bake at 180 °C for 28 to 30 minutes until set and golden.
Cut into 4 squares; keeps for 4 days chilled and reheats in a minute.

title: Canned salmon fish cakes with salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain well and mash.
Fold in the flaked salmon, spring onion, dill, lemon and salt and shape into 4 cakes.
Dip in the beaten egg, coat in the breadcrumbs and pan-fry in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with the rocket and yogurt.

title: Canned salmon and avocado rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Flake the drained salmon over the rice.
Add the sliced avocado, cucumber and spring onion.
Dress with the soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Lentil, sweet potato and spinach stew (meal prep)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin and paprika.
Add the lentils, cubed sweet potato, tomatoes, stock and salt.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils and sweet potato are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Portion into 4 containers; keeps for 4 days chilled or 3 months frozen.

title: No-bake protein oat balls
steps: Mix everything in a bowl until it comes together into a stiff dough.
Roll into 8 balls with damp hands.
Chill for 30 minutes to firm up; keeps for a week in the fridge.

title: Apple and cheddar
steps: Core and slice the apple.
Slice the cheddar.
Eat them together.

title: Herby yogurt dip with crunchy vegetables
steps: Stir the garlic powder, chopped dill, lemon, oil and salt into the yogurt.
Cut the carrot, celery and pepper into sticks.
Serve the vegetables with the dip.

title: Chocolate milk recovery shake
steps: Put the milk, cocoa, honey and whey in a shaker or blender.
Shake or blend until smooth.
Drink cold.

title: Cheddar, crispbread and grapes
steps: Slice the cheddar.
Arrange it on the crispbreads.
Serve with the grapes.

title: Quinoa, black bean and corn salad (meal prep)
steps: Simmer the quinoa for 12 to 15 minutes, drain and cool.
Toss with the drained beans, sweetcorn, diced pepper and spring onion.
Dress with the lime, oil, cumin, salt and coriander.
Divide between 4 containers; add the avocado just before eating. Keeps for 4 days chilled.

title: Turkey and hummus wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Layer on the turkey, spinach, cucumber and tomato.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

title: Savoury cottage cheese bowl with egg and seeds
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Add the chopped tomato and cucumber and the eggs.
Finish with the pumpkin seeds, oil and pepper.

title: Sardine, spinach and lemon rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice until tender and stir the spinach through it to wilt.
Flake the drained sardines over the top.
Dress with the lemon, oil and chilli.
